new_full_pose_result.axis_direction_method: Compare the two cylinder-axis signs using camera-facing end regions: a solid base supports interior end-disk returns, while an open lip should not.
new_full_pose_result.handle_roll_method: Use teal surface returns more than 4 mm outside the known 25 mm vessel radius to estimate the handle direction, then compare both axial-roll signs by point-direction consistency.

The handle roll estimate assumes the known handle lies along the mug body's positive local X direction.
